content.content:
122-Requires Hammerspoon to be running — there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this
123-stack, so `tests/test_init.lua` is executed through the `hs` CLI.
124-
125-Guards the bug classes that have actually bitten this file, rather than restating the
126-implementation:
127-
128:| Check | Catches |
129-|-------|---------|
130-| `syntax` | file no longer compiles |
131-| `locals` | the Lua 200-per-function ceiling |
132-| `scope` | a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function (reads as a nil global at runtime, with no load-time error) |
133-| `sound` | unguarded `hs.sound.getByFile(...):play()`, which throws and aborts its callback |
134-| `meeting` | meeting-mode code creeping back in |
135-| `globals` | state leaked into Hammerspoon's shared `_ENV` |
136-| `sort` | chunk files ordered as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999 |
137:| `emergencyStop` | emergency stop not cancelling a pending finalization |
138-
139:The `sort` checks extract the real comparator out of the source under test and execute
140-it, so they track the implementation instead of a copy that can drift.
141-
142-Because the suite takes a path argument, you can point it at an older revision to
143-confirm a check actually fails on the bug it claims to guard:
144-```bash
145-git show HEAD~1:hammerspoon/init.lua > /tmp/before.lua && ./tests/test_init.sh /tmp/before.lua
146-```
147-
148-### Common debug patterns
149-- **Refine not working**: Check `refine: failed` in logs — common causes: Ollama not running, wrong model name, missing `$HOME` env
150-- **Voice commands not matching**: Check `final (auto/...)` log line — whisper may have transcribed differently than expected
151-- **X button not closing overlay**: `hs.canvas:delete()` inside its own mouse callback is silently ignored — must use `canvas:hide()` immediately then defer deletion with `hs.timer.doAfter(0.01, ...)`
152-- **Recent dictations not persisting**: Lua upvalue scoping — never reassign a table variable that closures reference; populate in-place instead
